name: Grafana Dashboard Authoring
headline: Grafana Dashboard Authoring: Programmatic Dashboard
short_description: This skill allows users to create JSON-based dashboards in Grafana using its API. It is intended for developers and data analysts who need to generate and manage dashboards programmatically.
author: grafana

sections.overview:
The Grafana Dashboard Authoring skill enables developers and data analysts to create, configure, and organize Grafana dashboards through code. It covers core dashboard components including panels, variables, transformations, and thresholds, allowing you to automate dashboard generation and standardize dashboard design patterns across teams. This skill integrates with Grafana's API to support infrastructure-as-code workflows for observability platforms. Use it to dynamically generate dashboards from data models, implement dashboard templates, or maintain consistent visualization standards across multiple environments without manual UI work.
Generate dashboards dynamically based on data
Automate dashboard updates via scripts
Integrate dashboard creation in CI/CD pipelines
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/grafana/skills --skill dashboarding`
`git clone https://github.com/grafana/skills`
